body.displayDescription: Tier 95 two-handed bow with the Perfect Equilibrium passive and native Balance by Force special.
body.mechanicalImplementation: Physical Bow of the Last Guardian direct ranged hits build Perfect Equilibrium stacks; Balance by Force uses the four-stack window and can consume the three-stack pre-cast trigger. The separate Perfect Equilibrium hit has independent critical and ammunition provenance and does not generate another Perfect Equilibrium stack. Separate Perfect Equilibrium hits use explicit ammunition-origin and landed-state routing.
